items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: The trumpet section of that band is always great because they have Lew Soloff and Earl Gardner and Byron Stripling and Randy Brecker.

ctx.x: We know that. We heard that the other night.

Oh yes, well you know he’s been a good writer for a long time and he’s just wonderful. He’s still growing. It’s wonderful. It’s great. The trumpet section of that band is always great because they have Lew Soloff and Earl Gardner and Byron Stripling and Randy Brecker. If you want to have a successful — I always tell the arrangers if you want a successful arrangement with this band just write the trumpets in unison and it’s going to sound like no other band in the world. And then with Jon too then you have five.…
unbelievable. So he gets the best guys that are available to play in the band, which is really good.
